<p class="home-kicker">Crisis Counselor · Clinical Psychology Researcher</p>
<h1 class="home-title">Cole Rehbein</h1>
<section aria-label="Abstract" class="home-abstract">
<strong>Abstract:</strong> Crisis counselor and clinical psychology researcher building reproducible tools for behavioral-health research, communication, and care. High-acuity phone and chat triage and intervention for the 988 Suicide &amp; Crisis Lifeline network; M.S. in clinical/counseling psychology from New Mexico Highlands University (2026), with a thesis on mindfulness-based behavioral activation for depression. I use R, Quarto, Python, and technical writing to turn behavioral science into usable tools.
</section>
<p class="home-meta">
Albuquerque, NM &nbsp;·&nbsp; M.S. Clinical/Counseling Psychology, NMHU (2026) &nbsp;·&nbsp; 988 crisis lines, Fri–Mon nights &nbsp;·&nbsp; R / Quarto / Python &nbsp;·&nbsp; <a href="mailto:cole@cole.press">cole@cole.press</a>
</p>
